## E — Market signal

Status: no market research was performed for this section; the upstream competitive-intelligence pointer was not supplied for this run, so market size, pass rate, rooms, voice-of-customer quotes, persona, seasonality, price and success bar are recorded as typed debt (verify — MD-SEC-TWO-E-MARKET).
Known context only from the product frame: buyers are first-time Maryland applicants and the parents of teen drivers preparing for the MVA knowledge test.
Section angle: the graduated licensing timeline is a frequent source of confusion for parents of teen drivers, so the market pass should check how buyers ask about permit holding periods and practice hours.
Ad hooks, verbatim learner pain phrases and a named differentiation gap must come from sourced recon in a later pass, never invented here.
